\section*{Rules \raisebox{.2ex}{\footnotesize{ \normalfont \vspace*{-10pt} The building blocks of Rego } } }
\vspace{0.7em}


\vbox{%
\vspace{-1.5em}
\subsubsection*{Single-Value Rules}
\vspace{-0.5em}

\newcommand{\cheatText}{
	Single-value rules assign a single value. 
In older documentation, these are sometimes referred to as "complete rules".
}
\newcommand{\cheatLink}{
	https://play.openpolicyagent.org/?%3D%3D
}

\footnotesize{\tryitlink{\cheatText}{\cheatLink}}

\let\cheatLink\undefined
\let\cheatText\undefined

\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
default allow := false

allow if {
	input.user.role == "admin"
	input.user.internal
}

default request_quota := 100

request_quota := 1000 if input.user.internal
request_quota := 50 if input.user.plan.trial
\end{lstlisting}


}

\goodbreak


\vbox{%
\vspace{-1.5em}
\subsubsection*{Multi-Value Set Rules}
\vspace{-0.5em}

\newcommand{\cheatText}{
	Multi-value set rules generate and assign a set of values to a variable.
In older documentation these are sometimes referred to as "partial set rules".
}
\newcommand{\cheatLink}{
	https://play.openpolicyagent.org/?%3D
}

\footnotesize{\tryitlink{\cheatText}{\cheatLink}}

\let\cheatLink\undefined
\let\cheatText\undefined

\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
paths contains "/handbook/*"

paths contains path if {
	some team in input.user.teams
	path := sprintf("/teams/%v/*", [team])
}
\end{lstlisting}


\vspace{-0.4em}
\scriptsize{Output}
\vspace{-0.4em}
\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
{
  "paths": ["/handbook/*", "/teams/owl/*", "/teams/tiger/*"]
}
\end{lstlisting}

}

\goodbreak


\vbox{%
\vspace{-1.5em}
\subsubsection*{Multi-Value Object Rules}
\vspace{-0.5em}

\newcommand{\cheatText}{
	Multi-value object rules generate and assign a set of keys and values to a variable.
In older documentation these are sometimes referred to as "partial object rules".

}
\newcommand{\cheatLink}{
	https://play.openpolicyagent.org/?
}

\footnotesize{\tryitlink{\cheatText}{\cheatLink}}

\let\cheatLink\undefined
\let\cheatText\undefined

\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
# Creates an object with sets as the values.
paths_by_prefix[prefix] contains path if {
	some path in input.paths
	parts := split(path, "/")
	prefix := parts[0]
}
\end{lstlisting}


\vspace{-0.4em}
\scriptsize{Output}
\vspace{-0.4em}
\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
{
  "paths_by_prefix": {
    "a": ["a/123.txt", "a/456.txt"],
    "b": ["b/bar.txt", "b/foo.txt"],
    "c": ["c/x.txt"]
  }
}
\end{lstlisting}

}

\goodbreak



\section*{Iteration \raisebox{.2ex}{\footnotesize{ \normalfont \vspace*{-10pt} Make quick work of collections } } }
\vspace{0.7em}


\vbox{%
\vspace{-1.5em}
\subsubsection*{Some}
\vspace{-0.5em}

\newcommand{\cheatText}{
	Name local query variables.
}
\newcommand{\cheatLink}{
	https://play.openpolicyagent.org/?%3D%3D
}

\footnotesize{\tryitlink{\cheatText}{\cheatLink}}

\let\cheatLink\undefined
\let\cheatText\undefined

\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
all_regions := {
	"emea": {"west", "east"},
	"na": {"west", "east", "central"},
	"latam": {"west", "east"},
	"apac": {"north", "south"},
}

allowed_regions contains region_id if {
	some area, regions in all_regions

	some region in regions
	region_id := sprintf("%s_%s", [area, region])
}
\end{lstlisting}


\vspace{-0.4em}
\scriptsize{Output}
\vspace{-0.4em}
\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
{
  "allowed_regions": [
    "apac_north", "apac_south", "emea_east", ...
  ]
}
\end{lstlisting}

}

\goodbreak


\vbox{%
\vspace{-1.5em}
\subsubsection*{Every}
\vspace{-0.5em}

\newcommand{\cheatText}{
	Check conditions on many elements.
}
\newcommand{\cheatLink}{
	https://play.openpolicyagent.org/?%3D%3D
}

\footnotesize{\tryitlink{\cheatText}{\cheatLink}}

\let\cheatLink\undefined
\let\cheatText\undefined

\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
allow if {
	prefix := sprintf("/docs/%s/", [input.userID])
	every path in input.paths {
		startswith(path, prefix)
	}
}
\end{lstlisting}


}

\goodbreak



\section*{Control Flow \raisebox{.2ex}{\footnotesize{ \normalfont \vspace*{-10pt} Handle different conditions } } }
\vspace{0.7em}


\vbox{%
\vspace{-1.5em}
\subsubsection*{Logical AND}
\vspace{-0.5em}

\newcommand{\cheatText}{
	Statements in rules are joined with logical AND.
}
\newcommand{\cheatLink}{
	https://play.openpolicyagent.org/?state=eyJpIjoie1xuICBcImVtYWlsXCI6IFwiam9lQGV4YW1wbGUuY29tXCJcbn0iLCJwIjoicGFja2FnZSBjaGVhdFxuXG5cbnZhbGlkX3N0YWZmX2VtYWlsIGlmIHtcblx0cmVnZXgubWF0Y2goYF5cXFMrQFxcUytcXC5cXFMrJGAsIGlucHV0LmVtYWlsKSAjIGFuZFxuXHRlbmRzd2l0aChpbnB1dC5lbWFpbCwgXCJleGFtcGxlLmNvbVwiKVxufVxuIn0%3D
}

\footnotesize{\tryitlink{\cheatText}{\cheatLink}}

\let\cheatLink\undefined
\let\cheatText\undefined

\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
valid_staff_email if {
	regex.match(`^\S+@\S+\.\S+$`, input.email) # and
	endswith(input.email, "example.com")
}
\end{lstlisting}


}

\goodbreak


\vbox{%
\vspace{-1.5em}
\subsubsection*{Logical OR}
\vspace{-0.5em}

\newcommand{\cheatText}{
	Express OR with multiple rules, functions or the in keyword.
}
\newcommand{\cheatLink}{
	https://play.openpolicyagent.org/?%3D%3D
}

\footnotesize{\tryitlink{\cheatText}{\cheatLink}}

\let\cheatLink\undefined
\let\cheatText\undefined

\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
# using multiple rules
valid_email if endswith(input.email, "@example.com")
valid_email if endswith(input.email, "@example.org")
valid_email if endswith(input.email, "@example.net")

# using functions
allowed_firstname(name) if {
	startswith(name, "a")
	count(name) > 2
}

allowed_firstname("joe") # if name == 'joe'

valid_name if allowed_firstname(input.name)

valid_request if {
	input.method in {"GET", "POST"} # using `in`
}
\end{lstlisting}


\vspace{-0.4em}
\scriptsize{Output}
\vspace{-0.4em}
\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
{
  "email": "opa@example.com",
  "name": "anna",
  "method": "GET"
}
\end{lstlisting}

}

\goodbreak



\section*{Testing \raisebox{.2ex}{\footnotesize{ \normalfont \vspace*{-10pt} Validate your policy's behavior } } }
\vspace{0.7em}


\vbox{%
\vspace{-1.5em}
\subsubsection*{With}
\vspace{-0.5em}

\newcommand{\cheatText}{
	Override input and data using the with keyword.
}
\newcommand{\cheatLink}{
	https://play.openpolicyagent.org/?state=eyJpIjoie30iLCJwIjoicGFja2FnZSBjaGVhdFxuXG5cbmFsbG93IGlmIGlucHV0LmFkbWluID09IHRydWVcblxudGVzdF9hbGxvd193aGVuX2FkbWluIGlmIHtcblx0YWxsb3cgd2l0aCBpbnB1dCBhcyB7XCJhZG1pblwiOiB0cnVlfVxufVxuIn0%3D
}

\footnotesize{\tryitlink{\cheatText}{\cheatLink}}

\let\cheatLink\undefined
\let\cheatText\undefined

\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
allow if input.admin == true

test_allow_when_admin if {
	allow with input as {"admin": true}
}
\end{lstlisting}


}

\goodbreak



\section*{Debugging \raisebox{.2ex}{\footnotesize{ \normalfont \vspace*{-10pt} Find and fix problems } } }
\vspace{0.7em}


\vbox{%
\vspace{-1.5em}
\subsubsection*{Print}
\vspace{-0.5em}

\newcommand{\cheatText}{
	Use print in rules to inspect values at runtime.
}
\newcommand{\cheatLink}{
	https://play.openpolicyagent.org/?state=eyJpIjoie30iLCJwIjoicGFja2FnZSBjaGVhdFxuXG5cbmFsbG93ZWRfdXNlcnMgOj0ge1wiYWxpY2VcIiwgXCJib2JcIn1cblxuYWxsb3cgaWYge1xuXHRzb21lIHVzZXIgaW4gYWxsb3dlZF91c2Vyc1xuXHRwcmludCh1c2VyKVxuXHRpbnB1dC51c2VyID09IHVzZXJcbn1cbiJ9
}

\footnotesize{\tryitlink{\cheatText}{\cheatLink}}

\let\cheatLink\undefined
\let\cheatText\undefined

\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
allowed_users := {"alice", "bob"}

allow if {
	some user in allowed_users
	print(user)
	input.user == user
}
\end{lstlisting}


\vspace{-0.4em}
\scriptsize{Output}
\vspace{-0.4em}
\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
// alice
// bob
\end{lstlisting}

}

\goodbreak



\section*{Comprehensions \raisebox{.2ex}{\footnotesize{ \normalfont \vspace*{-10pt} Rework and process collections } } }
\vspace{0.7em}


\vbox{%
\vspace{-1.5em}
\subsubsection*{Arrays}
\vspace{-0.5em}

\newcommand{\cheatText}{
	Produce ordered collections, maintaining duplicates.

}
\newcommand{\cheatLink}{
	https://play.openpolicyagent.org/?state=eyJpIjoie30iLCJwIjoicGFja2FnZSBjaGVhdFxuXG5cbmRvdWJsZWQgOj0gW20gfFxuXHRzb21lIG4gaW4gWzEsIDIsIDMsIDNdXG5cdG0gOj0gbiAqIDJcbl1cbiJ9
}

\footnotesize{\tryitlink{\cheatText}{\cheatLink}}

\let\cheatLink\undefined
\let\cheatText\undefined

\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
doubled := [m |
	some n in [1, 2, 3, 3]
	m := n * 2
]
\end{lstlisting}


\vspace{-0.4em}
\scriptsize{Output}
\vspace{-0.4em}
\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
{ "doubled": [2, 4, 6, 6] }
\end{lstlisting}

}

\goodbreak

\vspace{-1.5em}
\subsubsection*{Sets}

\newcommand{\cheatText}{

\newcommand{\cheatLink}{
	https://play.openpolicyagent.org/?state=eyJpIjoie30iLCJwIjoicGFja2FnZSBjaGVhdFxuXG5cbnVuaXF1ZV9kb3VibGVkIGNvbnRhaW5zIG0gaWYge1xuXHRzb21lIG4gaW4gWzEwLCAyMCwgMzAsIDIwLCAxMF1cblx0bSA6PSBuICogMlxufVxuIn0%3D
}

}

\vbox{%
\vspace{-1.5em}
\subsubsection*{Objects}
\vspace{-0.5em}

\newcommand{\cheatText}{
	Produce key:value data. Note, keys must be unique.

}
\newcommand{\cheatLink}{
	https://play.openpolicyagent.org/?state=eyJpIjoie30iLCJwIjoicGFja2FnZSBjaGVhdFxuXG5cbmlzX2V2ZW5bbnVtYmVyXSA6PSBpc19ldmVuIGlmIHtcblx0c29tZSBudW1iZXIgaW4gWzEsIDIsIDMsIDRdXG5cdGlzX2V2ZW4gOj0gKG51bWJlciAlIDIpID09IDBcbn1cbiJ9
}

\footnotesize{\tryitlink{\cheatText}{\cheatLink}}

\let\cheatLink\undefined
\let\cheatText\undefined

\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
is_even[number] := is_even if {
	some number in [1, 2, 3, 4]
	is_even := (number % 2) == 0
}
\end{lstlisting}


\vspace{-0.4em}
\scriptsize{Output}
\vspace{-0.4em}
\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
{
  "is_even": {
    "1": false, "2": true, "3": false, "4": true
  }
}
\end{lstlisting}

}

\goodbreak



\section*{Builtins \raisebox{.2ex}{\footnotesize{ \normalfont \vspace*{-10pt} Handy functions for common tasks } } }
\vspace{0.7em}


\vbox{%
\vspace{-1.5em}
\subsubsection*{Regex}
\vspace{-0.5em}

\newcommand{\cheatText}{
	Pattern match and replace string data.
}
\newcommand{\cheatLink}{
	https://play.openpolicyagent.org/?state=eyJpIjoie30iLCJwIjoicGFja2FnZSBjaGVhdFxuXG5cbmV4YW1wbGVfc3RyaW5nIDo9IFwiQnVpbGQgUG9saWN5IGFzIENvZGUgd2l0aCBPUEEhXCJcblxuY2hlY2tfbWF0Y2ggaWYgcmVnZXgubWF0Y2goYFxcdytgLCBleGFtcGxlX3N0cmluZylcblxuY2hlY2tfcmVwbGFjZSA6PSByZWdleC5yZXBsYWNlKGV4YW1wbGVfc3RyaW5nLCBgXFxzK2AsIFwiX1wiKVxuIn0%3D
}

\footnotesize{\tryitlink{\cheatText}{\cheatLink}}

\let\cheatLink\undefined
\let\cheatText\undefined

\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
example_string := "Build Policy as Code with OPA!"

check_match if regex.match(`\w+`, example_string)

check_replace := regex.replace(example_string, `\s+`, "_")
\end{lstlisting}


\vspace{-0.4em}
\scriptsize{Output}
\vspace{-0.4em}
\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
{
  "check_match": true,
  "check_replace": "Build_Policy_as_Code_with_OPA!"
}
\end{lstlisting}

}

\goodbreak


\vbox{%
\vspace{-1.5em}
\subsubsection*{Strings}
\vspace{-0.5em}

\newcommand{\cheatText}{
	Check and transform strings.
}
\newcommand{\cheatLink}{
	https://play.openpolicyagent.org/?%3D%3D
}

\footnotesize{\tryitlink{\cheatText}{\cheatLink}}

\let\cheatLink\undefined
\let\cheatText\undefined

\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
example_string := "Build Policy as Code with OPA!"

check_contains if contains(example_string, "OPA")
check_startswith if startswith(example_string, "Build")
check_endswith if endswith(example_string, "!")
check_replace := replace(example_string, "OPA", "OPA!")
check_sprintf := sprintf("OPA is %s!", ["awesome"])
\end{lstlisting}


}

\goodbreak

\vspace{-1.5em}

	https://play.openpolicyagent.org/?state=eyJpIjoie30iLCJwIjoicGFja2FnZSBjaGVhdFxuXG5cbnZhbHMgOj0gWzUsIDEsIDQsIDIsIDNdXG52YWxzX2NvdW50IDo9IGNvdW50KHZhbHMpXG52YWxzX21heCA6PSBtYXgodmFscylcbnZhbHNfbWluIDo9IG1pbih2YWxzKVxudmFsc19zb3J0ZWQgOj0gc29ydCh2YWxzKVxudmFsc19zdW0gOj0gc3VtKHZhbHMpXG4ifQ%3D%3D

\vbox{%
\vspace{-1.5em}
\subsubsection*{Objects: Extracting Data}
\vspace{-0.5em}

\newcommand{\cheatText}{
	Work with key value and nested data.
}
\newcommand{\cheatLink}{
	https://play.openpolicyagent.org/?%3D%3D
}

\footnotesize{\tryitlink{\cheatText}{\cheatLink}}

\let\cheatLink\undefined
\let\cheatText\undefined

\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
obj := {"userid": "18472", "roles": [{"name": "admin"}]}

# paths can contain array indexes too
val := object.get(obj, ["roles", 0, "name"], "missing")

defaulted_val := object.get(
	obj,
	["roles", 0, "permissions"], # path
	"unknown", # default if path is missing
)

keys := object.keys(obj)
\end{lstlisting}


\vspace{-0.4em}
\scriptsize{Output}
\vspace{-0.4em}
\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
{
  "val": "admin",
  "defaulted_val": "unknown",

  "keys": ["roles", "userid"]
}
\end{lstlisting}

}

\goodbreak


\vbox{%
\vspace{-1.5em}
\subsubsection*{Objects: Transforming Data}
\vspace{-0.5em}

\newcommand{\cheatText}{
	Manipulate and make checks on objects.
}
\newcommand{\cheatLink}{
	https://play.openpolicyagent.org/?%3D%3D
}

\footnotesize{\tryitlink{\cheatText}{\cheatLink}}

\let\cheatLink\undefined
\let\cheatText\undefined

\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
unioned := object.union({"foo": true}, {"bar": false})

subset := object.subset(
	{"foo": true, "bar": false},
	{"foo": true}, # subset object
)

removed := object.remove(
	{"foo": true, "bar": false},
	{"bar"}, # remove keys
)
\end{lstlisting}


\vspace{-0.4em}
\scriptsize{Output}
\vspace{-0.4em}
\begin{lstlisting}[language=Ruby]
{
  "removed": { "foo": true },
  "subset": true,
  "unioned": { "bar": false, "foo": true }
}
\end{lstlisting}

}

\goodbreak
